newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk aluminium firm seeks partners to up capacity.
newsitem.headline: Turk aluminium firm seeks partners to up capacity.

text.p: Turkey's state aluminium smelter Seydisehir, fully owned by its parent company Etibank, is seeking foreign or local partners for a capacity increase project which may cost up to $350 million, a company official said on Wednesday.
"We are announcing an invitation to foreign and local companies to set up an investment partnership to upgrade our plant," said a senior official from the company.
The plant, the only aluminium smelter in Turkey, has a production capacity of 60,000 tonnes of primary aluminium a year.
"The exact cost of the project will be determined by the partners but its estimated level is up to $350 million," the official told Reuters.
He said the invitation was published in the Official Gazette on Wednesday.
The project envisages uprading the alumina refinery, smelter, and casting and rolling units at the plant, located 350 km to the south of Ankara.
The project, which was first proposed in 1992 but later shelved by the government due to financial difficulties, aims to raise capacity to 100,000 tonnes a year.
